payload.title: papyrus-infra silently defaults CDK account to legacy 335163751677; resolve via STS
payload.description: bin/papyrus-infra.mjs falls back to legacy account 335163751677 when --account and CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT are unset (Amplify builds), so deploy fails assuming the legacy CDK deploy role (Pilobolus builds 37/38). Fix: resolve account via aws sts get-caller-identity, region from AWS_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION/CDK_DEFAULT_REGION default us-east-1, clear error otherwise.
